verdict.line: You lose if you let Sett bank a full Grit bar and chain Q into E-stun on you; you win if you pull with E before his cooldowns are up and land Q as a single-target smash.

brief.thesis: This is a 49.2% head-to-head over 3120 games because both champions win their all-in off the same pattern: land a stun/pull, then empowered damage. Sett's edge is a passively-charging Grit meter that turns punishment into a bigger W shield-and-burst, while Mordekaiser's edge is that his own E (Death's Grasp) and R (Realm of Death) don't care about Sett's passive regen or Grit at all. Whoever time their lockdown around the other's cooldowns wins the exchange.

theirWindow.when: Sett's Grit bar looks full and Q is up
theirWindow.what: He can combo empowered Knuckle Down autos into a big Haymaker shield-and-punch. Don't stand and trade through it — back off a step or hold W (Indestructible) to bank the incoming damage into your own shield.

yourWindow.when: his E (Facebreaker) and Q are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk in and land E (Death's Grasp) to pull him, then Q (Obliterate) for the single-target bonus damage. This is also when Darkness Rise procs cleanest since he can't punish the follow-up with a stun.

runes.keystoneWhy: Both of you win fights by committing to extended melee trades — Conqueror's healing keeps you ahead of his Grit regen instead of behind it.

summoners.why: 78.5% pick rate — Ignite cuts off the healthbar-based regen from his passive (Pit Grit) right when you're trying to close out an even trade.

playing.title: Track his left/right punch alternation
playing.detail: His passive's right punch hits harder and faster. Don't commit to a long auto-trade right as his right punch comes up.

playing.title: Hold W for his Haymaker
playing.detail: Indestructible banks the true/physical damage from his W punch into your own shield — time your cast to his W animation, not before it.

playing.title: Don't get caught between him and a minion
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if enemies are on opposite sides of him; if you're alone on one side it just slows you. Stay off the minion wave's far side so a stray minion doesn't give him the stun.

playing.title: Pull before he resets his stun
playing.detail: E into Q as soon as you see his E (Facebreaker) go on cooldown — that's the one window he can't punish your engage with a stun.

playing.title: Buy armor before you commit to extended fights
playing.detail: Get Plated Steelcaps and armor items up before closing distance — his damage is almost entirely physical, so armor timing decides the trade.

playing.title: Save R to remove him from skirmishes
playing.detail: Realm of Death takes him out of the fight entirely and steals a cut of his stats — use it in skirmishes where his damage would otherwise swing the fight, not just for the kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks above are the measured choices from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own read of the matchup, not OP.GG-sourced.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Plated Steelcaps and other items with armor before closing in to fight Sett. Try to use [W] when he uses (W).
